description: Reads the customer card of a helpdesk ticket: what the account's own system (its client area, CRM or ERP) knows about the correspondent, asked live by their address, such as their account, their services and when they renew, and what they owe. "status" says "found" with the card, "not_found" when that system does not know them, "unavailable" when it did not answer (ask again later, it says nothing about the customer), "unverified" when it was not asked because the latest message names its correspondent through a Reply-To that nothing authenticates (nothing proves that person wrote, so do not discuss their account by email), and "none" when the account has no such system connected or the thread is somebody's mailbox. Read it before answering a customer about their account, a renewal or an invoice.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it.

name: get_customer_card
title: Read what the account knows about a ticket's customer
